## Parental OpControl 0.17.2

- Fixed a process-detection bug in the Windows service and Helper. The My OpControl window and the Luna moon share the same executable, so the service could mistake an open My OpControl window for the Luna moon. That could stop the kid window when Luna was off, or keep the moon from starting when Luna was on. The detection now reads the process command line (`--kid-window`) and only treats the real moon as Luna.
- No Luna, dashboard or data changes. The update is safe for the X1; Luna stays on with the same key.
